source.name: GM Authority - Cadillac F1 Team Makes Its Statement With 2026 Livery: Video
source.quote: The rest of the Cadillac F1 race car’s nose is populated by sponsor logos, showcasing whiskey distiller Jim Beam, emissions control system manufacturer Tenneco, and clothing brand Tommy Hilfiger.
source.note: On the nose per GM Authority; Motorsport.com puts Jim Beam on the bargeboards (conflict).

note: Cadillac Formula 1 Team front partner on the 2026 car.
